description: Price of ONE Citizens City commodity in APEX from its on-chain AMM pool: price, token and APEX reserves (depth), fee and burn in basis points, whether it is tradeable or paused, and the minimum buy. Pass the name, e.g. "Tomato", "Truffle", "Voidbloom"; an unknown name returns the list of names. For every market at once use commodity_markets; to trade, commodity_swap_build.
name: commodity_price
